title: A note on surfaces with large systoles
summary: We show that for every sufficiently large genus $g$, there exists a closed hyperbolic surface $S_g$ with systole $\mathrm{sys}(S_g)\geq \log g-12\log\log g$. In particular, $$\liminf_{g\to \infty}\frac{\max\{\mathrm{sys}(S):S\in \mathcal{M}_g\}}{\log g}\geq 1,$$ improving the previously known bound $2/9$. This note is a continuation of our previous work on the diameter of finite covers arXiv:2608.12887, using the same framework of constant-twist pants decomposition to study systoles. The proof was developed by GPT-5.6 Sol through an extended discussion with the author.
